task_info.problem_statement: Issue Title: [Bug]: LocalWorkspace.list_tools raises AttributeError on current main Description: ## Description `LocalWorkspace.list_tools()` raises the following exception on the current `main` branch: ```text AttributeError: 'LocalWorkspace' object has no attribute '_glob_helper_path' ``` This prevents the agent service from constructing the toolkit for a local workspace when a user starts a chat. ## Reproduction Environment: - AgentScope: editable installation from current `main` - Python: 3.11.12 - Workspace: `LocalWorkspace` ```python import asyncio import tempfile from agentscope.workspace import LocalWorkspace async def main() -> None: with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as path: workspace = LocalWorkspace(workdir=path) await workspace.initialize() try: await workspace.list_tools() finally: await workspace.close() asyncio.run(main()) ``` ## Root cause This appears to be a regression introduced by commit `81538d35`. The v2.0.4 release and the parent of that commit both define the following default on `WorkspaceBase`: ```python _glob_helper_path: str | None = None ``` The commit removed that attribute while retaining the access in `WorkspaceBase.list_tools()`. `SandboxedWorkspaceBase` overrides `_glob_helper_path`, but `LocalWorkspace` inherits directly from `WorkspaceBase`, so the attribute is missing. ## Suggested fix Restore the default `_glob_helper_path: str | None = None` class attribute on `WorkspaceBase` and add a regression test covering `LocalWorkspace.list_tools()`. @DavdGao, I would be happy to submit the small fix and regression test if this approach looks good.
